name: Udonya
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood udon shop: a delivery service announcement, a first day helping boil udon, a menu and price list with a point-card bonus, a takeout tempura service notice, an extra-serving-size comparison, a column on learning to ask customers how firm they like their noodles, a part-timer lesson on basic dashi stock-taking, an explainer on why a hand-made-noodle experience corner started, a limited-menu udon application guide, a column on how more takeout orders changed the shop's day, a busy-season reception rule, a column on the meaning of an udon shop's craft, and a one-year cooperation report with a flour-milling supplier.
